MRI Information
MR Conditional (1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only): spatial field gradient ≤ 40 T/m; at 1.5 T: maximum B1+rms of 3.2 microtesla, head SAR ≤ 3.2 W/kg, Maximum active scan time of 60 minutes; at 3 T: B1+RMS of 1.7 µT or less; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 0.4 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode.
Device configuration during MRI: Stimulation OFF.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
